[[Peace]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Divine Peacekeeper]]s and [[White Mantle Priest]]s during the [[War in Kryta]].

== Stats ==
:[[Fire damage|Fire Dmg]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]])
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)

== Replica ==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
* One of the following [[Divine Favor]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Divine Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
** [[Holy Rod]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
** [[Norn Scepter]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scepter]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Scepter]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Scepter]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Scepter]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
* [[Perfect]] [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Quickening]]
* Perfect "[[Inscription#Hale_and_Hearty|Hale and Hearty]]" inscription

== Unique counterparts ==
*[[Mallyx's Faith]] has stats identical to this item.
*[[Chidehkir's Deliverance]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[holy damage]] and requires [[Healing Prayers]].
* [[Imperial Dragon Wand]], [[The People's Will]] and [[Xun Rao's Justice]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they require [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].
* [[Plague-Soaked Stave]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Dark damage]] and requires Divine Favor, Soul Reaping, Fast Casting, Energy Storage, or Spawning Power.
